blocks.text: Published: 24 October 2026. Effective: 7 November 2026.
Substantive changes take effect after 14 days’ notice. The previous version is available below.

HyperChat is a product of STREAMHEART PRIVATE LIMITED (“HyperChat”, “we”, “us”). Our registered office is G-478, G BLOCK, GOVINDPURAM PARK, BLOCK 1, Govindpuram, Ghaziabad, India. Our privacy and grievance contact is ankit@hyperchat.space.

This notice explains our processing of personal data for creator accounts, audience interactions, payments, settlements and support. A creator may separately process information in their broadcast or community. We remain responsible for purposes we determine, even when other providers help deliver the service.

items: Creator accounts: contact and channel details, account identifiers and permissions needed to review onboarding, operate accounts and secure access.

Audience interactions: submitted display names, text, voice recordings, images or other supported media, creator destination and delivery/moderation records, to validate, review, queue and deliver the interaction and provide a limited interaction history. Do not submit another person's private data or recording without appropriate authority.

Text-to-speech: submitted text and voice/language choices needed to generate the requested audio. Recorded voice messages instead use the viewer's own audio. Providers and any additional uses must be disclosed at the relevant feature. Acceptance of this notice is not permission for unrelated voice cloning or training.

KYC: identity information is submitted to Didit for verification. HyperChat receives the KYC completion status linked to the creator account. HyperChat does not store KYC identity documents, face images or biometric records. Didit's own collection and retention are explained through its notice and the verification flow; our deletion schedule does not by itself delete Didit records.

Payments and settlements: payments use a payment aggregator/gateway. Streamheart settles creator funds and stores transaction IDs, amounts and payout records for reconciliation, refunds, settlement and required accounting. HyperChat does not store payer details as payment records. A separately submitted viewer display name or message can still identify a person. Payment providers process payment information under their applicable notices.

Security and service operation: necessary authentication/session information, access and security logs and troubleshooting records, to operate the service, protect accounts and investigate failures or misuse.
Support: information you provide in requests and relevant account/service records, to respond, investigate and resolve grievances.

blocks.text: We identify required data at collection and explain the feature consequences of not providing it. Optional analytics, marketing, external moderation or other additional processing must have its own accurate notice and choice where required. This policy does not authorize unspecified future purposes.

Where consent is required, we provide a clear notice identifying the personal data and specified purpose and seek free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous consent through affirmative action. Merely browsing or accepting Terms does not mean consent to all processing. Optional purposes are separate.

We may use other grounds expressly permitted by applicable Indian law when their conditions are met, including specified legitimate uses or binding legal duties. We do not claim a general right to process anything for “business interests”.

You can withdraw consent by emailing ankit@hyperchat.space and through any consent control offered for the feature. Withdrawal must be as easy as giving consent. We stop the consent-based processing and instruct relevant processors to stop within applicable periods, unless continued processing is required or otherwise authorized by law. Withdrawal does not undo lawful processing already completed. We explain when a requested feature cannot continue without that data.

An interaction may be received by a creator and their authorized moderators. If selected for broadcast, its intended display name, text, media or audio may appear in a live stream, replay or clip. The submission notice must explain this before sending. Payer details are not made public merely because an interaction is broadcast.

Independent copies made by creators, streaming platforms or viewers may remain outside our control. We act on data we control and assist with relevant requests; we cannot guarantee retrieval of every public copy. Your statutory rights remain.

We use service providers for the relevant hosting, storage, delivery, verification, voice, support and payment functions. We disclose data only for identified purposes, valid choices or lawful requirements, with appropriate contracts and safeguards. When external moderation is enabled, the integration notice explains the data and recipients involved. Provider names and any independent purposes must be identified at the relevant collection or integration point. No unrelated marketing, AI training or voice reuse is authorized simply by using the service.

Current practice and planned changes: Interactions currently have no automatic expiry. Automatic retention limits, restricted archives and scheduled deletion are being prepared; they are not yet deployed. We are not promising that existing interactions are automatically erased or hidden after 30 or 90 days. Contact ankit@hyperchat.space to request access, withdrawal or erasure; requests are reviewed against applicable legal obligations and the data we control.

The planned limits are 30 days of routine availability for voice/media, 90 days for interaction text/history, and removal of ordinary account access within 30 days of closure. These limits require separate backend implementation and a revised operational notice when available. Our goal is to end indefinite routine retention, while preserving required records in a restricted archive. The applicable statutory retention minimums below take precedence when operative.

Required retention: Where applicable law requires it, we preserve personal data, related traffic records and processing logs for at least one year from the relevant processing. This can include interaction content, not just transaction IDs. Planned removal from routine playback or creator history does not mean that legally required copies have been erased. Required archives must be restricted to their permitted purposes; that archive design remains part of the pending implementation.

Applicable rules require erasure after the required period unless further retention is required by another applicable law or Government notification. Our policy is to preserve necessary transaction IDs, amounts and payout/accounting records for eight financial years following the record's financial year where company accounting law requires it, or a longer applicable legal period. A financial record requirement alone does not justify preserving all media for that same accounting period; the separate one-year processing-data requirement must still be assessed.

A documented legal hold is limited to its valid scope and reviewed at least every 90 days. We explain required preservation in response to erasure requests and instruct relevant processors consistently. Backups cannot be used as a substitute for a required retention archive. Deleted records remaining in isolated backups expire within the proposed 90-day backup cycle only where lawful; a statutory final-erasure deadline takes precedence, and restoration must reapply deletions.

When an applicable inactivity-based deletion requirement covers an account, we provide the required advance notice and explain how the user can respond. An inactivity period does not authorize indefinite retention or override other applicable preservation or deletion duties.

We apply reasonable technical and organizational safeguards and require appropriate safeguards from processors. These include access restrictions, protection of data in transit and storage, monitoring, recovery and incident response appropriate to the risk. We do not guarantee that any system is completely risk-free.

If a personal data breach occurs, we notify affected individuals without delay where required by applicable law, using their registered account or contact channel. We explain what happened, the likely consequences, what we are doing, steps they can take, and how to contact us.

We notify the competent data-protection authority without delay where required and provide the required detailed follow-up within 72 hours of awareness, unless an extension is granted. This follow-up period does not delay the initial notification. Other applicable reporting duties and shorter deadlines also apply.

HyperChat is available only to individuals aged 18 or older. Do not create an account or submit an interaction if you are under 18. Creator KYC does not establish viewer age; age controls must cover the relevant service users.

Creators complete verification through Didit. Our creator policy requires renewed KYC each Indian financial year, from 1 April to 31 March. This is a HyperChat account requirement. Separate financial or verification obligations may also apply.

If we learn that a child's data was collected contrary to this policy or law, we restrict further processing, investigate and erase it unless lawful preservation is required. Report concerns to ankit@hyperchat.space. We respect legal agency and follow any applicable requirements for persons represented by lawful guardians.
Subject to the Act's scope, conditions and applicable exemptions, you may request:

items: A summary of personal data and processing activities, and prescribed information about Data Fiduciaries and processors with whom data was shared.
Correction, completion and updating of inaccurate or incomplete personal data.
Erasure, subject to lawful retention and applicable requirements.
Withdrawal of consent and redressal of grievances.
Nomination in the legally prescribed manner of one or more individuals to exercise relevant rights following your death or incapacity.

blocks.text: For consent withdrawal, access, correction, erasure, nomination or a privacy complaint, email ankit@hyperchat.space or use the Contact Support link above. Include your account email or username, the request type and an interaction reference if relevant. Do not send passwords, OTPs or fresh KYC documents. We verify identity and authority proportionately. Our service target is to acknowledge requests within 48 hours and resolve them within 30 days, subject to any shorter legal requirement. We explain delays, lawful refusals, retained records and available escalation. Where the statutory grievance-response cap applies, our published response period will not exceed 90 days; the shorter 30-day service target remains our aim.

Please first contact us so we can investigate your grievance. If it remains unresolved, you may complain to the competent data-protection authority through the legally available process after completing any required internal grievance steps. This does not waive your statutory rights. Please provide truthful information and do not impersonate someone else or submit false complaints.

Provider processing outside India is subject to applicable Government restrictions, sectoral requirements and appropriate arrangements. We do not promise India-only processing. Relevant locations and providers must be disclosed accurately through our collection notices and provider information.

Material changes receive an accurate revision date and any additional notice or fresh consent required by law. A new notice does not retrospectively authorize a new purpose. We provide required notices and consent choices in clear language, with language access as required by law. For notices, language requests and privacy questions, contact ankit@hyperchat.space.

These revised policies were published on 24 October 2026, with substantive changes effective 7 November 2026. We publish an updated date and provide additional notice or obtain fresh consent where required when our purposes or practices change. The rules that apply depend on the law in force at the relevant time. This policy does not replace clear notices and choices at the point where your information is collected.
